links.outcome: Agreement (ICC) between GenAI scores and clinician educator consensus on local Japanese transcripts
links.effect: Overall ICC 0.04 (95% CI 0.00 to 0.09) for GPT-5.2 Thinking and 0.22 (95% CI 0.10 to 0.35) for Gemini 3.0 Pro; mean scores 3.68 and 4.09 vs educator 5.18 (P<.001).
links.quote: Agreement between the GenAI models and the clinical educator consensus ratings was poor across all domains, with overall intraclass correlation coefficients of 0.04 (95% CI 0.00 to 0.09) for GPT-5.2 Thinking and 0.22 (95% CI 0.10 to 0.35) for Gemini 3.0 Pro.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing generative LLM scoring against clinical educator consensus for grading medical resident interview transcripts. Evaluates model performance without testing specific deployment safeguards.
